title: Make the shipping label the same width as the pallet
goal: uses box-sizing to control which areas are included when an element declares its width.
summary: The shipping label has been set to be as wide as the pallet, but after adding the border and padding, it exceeds the dotted line.
tasks: Set the box model of .parcel-label to border-box.
retains width: 100%, 10px padding and 2px solid border, so that the outer border of the label is exactly the same width as the tray.

example.note: border box includes both content, left and right padding, and left and right borders. The middle content area here is 140px.

hint: content-box uses width for the content area, and borders and padding will increase the outer width of the box. Use border-box to include these spaces in width.
